# Upgrade .NET projects to .NET 10

## Preferences
- **Flow Mode**: Automatic
- **Target Framework**: net10.0

## Source Control
- **Source Branch**: Development
- **Working Branch**: upgrade-dotnet-10
- **Commit Strategy**: After Each Task
- **Branch Sync**: Auto (Merge)

## Upgrade Options
- **Upgrade Strategy**: all-at-once
- **Package Update Policy**: update-all
- **Deprecated Package Handling**: replace-when-available
- **Commit Strategy**: single
- **Test & Validation**: run-full-tests
